_meta.description: kg CO2e per tonne treated. direct = UK DESNZ 2026 reporting factors (cut-off: no credit for avoided virgin material; DESNZ itself says they cannot compare routes). net = US EPA WARM v16 lifecycle factors incl. avoided production, used for the route comparison. Both already include a default collection leg; transport beyond 25 km is added from transport.json.
